author: FibonacciFox
description: A library that extends PeachPie capabilities for Avalonia UI.
name: Avalonia PHP Library

postActions.description: Generate PHP stubs (NuGet vendor stubs + reflection stubs).

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet msbuild -t:PeachpieStubs' to restore vendor stubs and generate PHP stubs into <project>/vendor/Stubs

postActions.description: Сгенерировать PHP заглушки (vendor из NuGet + рефлексия).

manualInstructions.text: Выполните 'dotnet msbuild -t:PeachpieStubs', чтобы восстановить vendor-заглушки и сгенерировать PHP-заглушки в <проект>/vendor/Stubs
